description: He wears an opaque cream long tunic with gold geometric edging along its slit neckline, front and cuffs under a dark charcoal-brown ankle-length open robe. The robe has wide sleeves and elaborate gold geometric woven borders down the front and around the sleeve ends and hem. A broad brown-and-gold patterned sash wraps the waist, with long richly patterned ends and tassels hanging to one side. The cream tunic falls to the lower legs, above dark fitted trousers. Low brown closed-toe shoes have gold patterned uppers. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
